speedScale.description: Scaling factor for player movement and obstacle speed. Higher values increase speed and difficulty.

invincibilityDuration.description: Duration in seconds of player invincibility when acquiring the shield power-up.

magnetRadius.description: Attraction radius for coins while the magnet power-up is active. Higher values pull coins from further away.

coinSpawnRate.description: Frequency and density modifier for spawning coins in the lanes. Higher values increase coin density.
